content.short: Radiant Capital is an omnichain money market that unifies fragmented liquidity across major blockchain networks.
content.description:
Radiant Capital is a pioneering decentralized finance protocol designed to solve the problem of fragmented liquidity by enabling users to interact with a single, unified money market across multiple chains. Built on top of LayerZero technology, the platform allows participants to deposit collateral on one network—such as Arbitrum—and borrow assets natively on another, like BNB Chain or Ethereum. This approach significantly enhances capital efficiency and provides a more seamless decentralized banking experience.

Powered by the RDNT token, the protocol features a unique "Dynamic Liquidity" (dLP) model that incentivizes long-term participation through revenue-sharing rewards for those who lock liquidity. Radiant focuses on professional-grade risk management and transparent on-chain execution, serving as a primary liquidity hub for major digital assets. Through its commitment to cross-chain innovation and institutional-grade financial tools, Radiant Capital is building the essential infrastructure needed for a truly interconnected global decentralized economy.
content.meta: Radiant Capital provides omnichain lending and borrowing services, unifying liquidity across multiple blockchain networks.
